name: Robot Assistant Builder
tag: Guides you through building a voice-controlled robot assistant and teaching it your commands.

scenarios.title: Build your first assistant
scenarios.ask: Help me build a voice robot with the {kit} and {arms} arm(s).
steps: Planner
Picked parts: a small computer board, microphone, speaker, {=2 + arms * 3} motors and a frame.
Assembler
Wrote {=10 + kit * 4 + arms * 5} build steps with 3D views of each part.
Wiring
Checked each wire on a diagram before power-on.
Voice
Loaded a wake word and 10 starter commands like 'turn left' and 'what time is it'.
followups: The starter kit uses plug-in wires. The advanced kit has a few optional solder joints with step-by-step help.
Yes. Speech for your own commands runs on the board, so nothing leaves the robot unless you allow it.

scenarios.title: Teach custom commands
scenarios.ask: Teach my robot {cmds} new commands with {samples} voice samples each.
steps: Recorder
Prompted you to say each command {samples} times in a normal voice.
Trainer
Trained on {=cmds * samples} samples on the robot itself.
Tester
Ran each command and checked the robot's action matched.
Tuner
Flagged commands that sound alike, such as 'lift' and 'left'.

result.title: Commands learned
rows: About {=min(97, 82 + samples * 2)}% in a quiet room (estimate)

followups: Add a few samples from each person who will use it. Accuracy for new voices improves fast.
Can a command run a sequence?
Yes. One phrase can trigger several actions, like 'tidy up' moving to a spot, picking up and dropping into a bin.

scenarios.title: Run a classroom build
scenarios.ask: {students} students will build robots in teams of {team} over {sessions} sessions.
steps: Planner
Made {=ceil(students / team)} teams and one kit per team.
Lesson builder
Split the build into {sessions} sessions, about {=round(30 / sessions, 1)} steps each.
Roles
Rotated builder, wirer and tester roles every session.
Showcase
Set a final challenge: each robot follows 5 spoken commands.
followups: What if a team falls behind?
The teacher view shows each team's step, and the tutor gives hints so they catch up.
Yes. Everything comes apart, and the app has a teardown checklist.
